cd /workspace/tmp && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
from harness import *
def H(callid='c1', cseq=1, tag='t'):
    return [("From","<sip:alice@lab.test>;tag=%s"%tag),("To","<sip:bob@lab.test>"),("Call-ID",callid),("CSeq","%d MESSAGE"%cseq)]
d = basic_doc()
d['config']['peers'].append({"id":"rel","mode":"relay","accounts":["alice"]})
d['events']=[
  ev(t=0, w=wire(headers=H())),
  ev(t=1, w=wire(headers=H(), body=b'x')),
  ev(t=2, peer='rel', auth=None, w=wire(headers=H())),
  ev(t=3, w=wire(headers=H(cseq=2))),
  ev(t=4, w=wire(headers=H(cseq=2), body=b'x')),
  {"t":5,"peer":"edge","auth":"alice","egress":"external","wire_hex":"abc"},
  ev(t=6, w=wire(headers=H(tag='u', cseq=2))),
  ev(t=7, w=wire(method='INVITE', headers=[("From","<sip:alice@lab.test>;tag=t"),("To","<sip:bob@lab.test>"),("Call-ID","c1"),("CSeq","1 INVITE")])),
]
out = decisions(d)
for r in out['results']:
    print(r['index'], r['decision'], r.get('reason'), r.get('first'))
print('counts', out['accepted'], out['replayed'], out['rejected'], out['live'])
PYEOF
